text: なかなか　やりての　ようだな　おて　あわせ　ねがおうか！

structure.jp: なかなか　やりての　ようだな
おて　あわせ　ねがおうか！
structure.en: shall I ask you for a match!

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ says 'it looks like, it seems', a guess from what the speaker sees. After a thing-word it needs の. やりての　ようだ = 'you seem to be a capable one'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The おう ending means 'let's' or 'I shall', and with か it becomes 'shall I?'. ねがおうか = 'shall I ask you for it?'
